The missing sampler prevents training, and the redundant calibration import can prevent diagnosis_tools.py from loading. Calibration also omits clean causal controls, counts feature differences as mutation witnesses, and presents comparisons against clean-model outputs without clearly identifying that oracle dependency. The changes below address these issues without changing the architecture or production predictor.

def sample_batch(user_train, itemnum, batch_size, maxlen, users=None):
    if min(itemnum, batch_size, maxlen) <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Sampler dimensions must be positive")
    if users is None:
        users = [
            u for u, h in user_train.items()
            if len(h) >= 2 and len(set(h)) < itemnum
        ]
    if not users:
        raise ValueError("No eligible training users")
    sequences = np.zeros((batch_size, maxlen), dtype=np.int64)
    positives = np.zeros_like(sequences)
    negatives = np.zeros_like(sequences)
    for row in range(batch_size):
        user = users[np.random.randint(len(users))]
        history = user_train[user]
        if any(item < 1 or item > itemnum for item in history):
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid mapped history for training user {user}")
        excluded = set(history)
        if len(history) < 2 or len(excluded) >= itemnum:
            raise ValueError(f"Ineligible cached training user {user}")
        target = history[-1]
        position = maxlen - 1
        for item in reversed(history[:-1]):
            sequences[row, position] = item
            positives[row, position] = target
            negative = np.random.randint(1, itemnum + 1)
            while negative in excluded:
                negative = np.random.randint(1, itemnum + 1)
            negatives[row, position] = negative
            target = item
            position -= 1
            if position < 0:
                break
    return sequences, positives, negatives
